verdict.rationale: On the Claude API, skills take an optional `version` in the container parameter and there is a Skill Versions API for version management, so API users can pin a skill version. In Claude Code, plugins carry a version in `plugin.json` and support versioned releases, but marketplaces advertise automatic updates, and nothing documents a way to pin or freeze them. Missing for 10: a lockfile or pinning mechanism for Claude Code plugins and marketplaces, a documented way to disable or gate automatic updates, team-wide rollout control, and independent or hands-on corroboration of version pinning.
